cues.en: I mean there's, apart from this little tiny spike here which isn't really even there, there's a little bit of over fitting going there, but we have basically created that spiral shape just out of this handful of neurons.
cues.zh: 除了這個幾乎看不見的小尖峰，還有一點過度擬合之外，基本上只用這少數神經元，就建立了螺旋形。

cues.en: God, I could do this all day, guys, and I hope you will too.
cues.zh: 各位，我可以玩一整天，希望你們也會。

cues.en: Just play around with this, it's so much fun, and it gives you such a concrete understanding of what's going on under the hood.
cues.zh: 盡情實驗，非常有趣，也能讓你非常具體地理解內部運作。

cues.en: I mean look at this hidden layer here.
cues.zh: 看看這個隱藏層。

cues.en: That's where these spiral shapes are starting to emerge and come together, and when you think about the fact that your brain works in very much the same way, it's quite literally mind blowing.
cues.zh: 螺旋形就是從這裡開始浮現、組合起來。想到大腦也以非常相似的方式運作，真的讓人驚嘆。

cues.en: Anyway, mess around with this, it's a really great exercise and I hope you have some fun with it.
cues.zh: 總之，玩玩看，這是很棒的練習，希望你樂在其中。
